entries.prompt: Create a TWO-FRAME FRONT-FACING WALK cycle for ONLY the small bandit at TOP LEFT of this enemy roster. Exact same identity: huge dark-brown sculpted hair, wide red headband with tails on IMAGE LEFT, red cloth covering mouth, brown sleeveless tunic, belt, stubby dark pants and round brown shoes. Knife remains in his anatomical LEFT hand (on IMAGE RIGHT) in BOTH frames; NEVER swap hands or mirror headband/hair/light. Wide transparent sprite sheet 1536x768 with TWO equal 768x768 cells. Both figures have identical pixel height, head scale and front-facing slightly overhead 20 degree camera, centered x384 in each cell, shoes ground baseline y690, head top y100. LEFT FRAME: image-left leg reaches forward (shoe visibly lower/larger toward viewer), image-right leg trails (shoe higher), free right hand on image-left swings backward slightly, knife hand on image-right swings forward. RIGHT FRAME: image-right leg reaches forward (its shoe lower), image-left leg trails (shoe higher); free hand on image-left swings forward and knife hand on image-right moves back slightly. Only short leg/arm motion and 1 percent head bob, not a new viewpoint. Keep face, brow, hair, headband, body mass and cloth details identical. No side or back view. High-resolution smooth softly sculpted pre-rendered chibi material exactly like reference, warm upper-left highlights consistent in both cells. Clearly visible separated feet and short legs, no ground shadows or floor, no labels, no text, no UI or divider. TRUE ALPHA background, solid opaque body with clean antialiased edges. All parts fully inside their cells.

Edit ONLY the LOWER TWO CELLS of this 2x2 transparent walking sprite sheet. Keep the upper two cells pixel-faithful in design, pose, framing and scale. The lower-left currently repeats the upper-left leading leg and forward hand, so it is NOT a proper left-right walk cycle. Fix this precisely: in LOWER-LEFT cell, the hand on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE must be SWUNG FORWARD and visibly bent up near the chest, while the hand on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE must be SWUNG BACK and held low beside/behind the hip. The lower-left leg contact pose must be the opposite physical leg from upper-left: the leg emerging from the LEFT SIDE of the shorts is in front and reaches to the character's front; the leg emerging from the RIGHT SIDE of the shorts is behind, knee bent back. Keep the face and hair pointed in EXACTLY the same screen-right three-quarter direction; do NOT mirror the whole body or reverse lighting. Lower-right is the passing phase following that opposite contact: the opposite foot is planted under the pelvis while the other knee passes, and arms return close to sides. Make the two leg chains easy to distinguish with the same shorts/shoe colors and soft ambient occlusion. No foot overlap that hides which leg leads. All four cells stay identical camera, size, head and costume identity; head position and ground-contact baseline stay aligned. Keep the head extremely large and body compact as existing. The first row must stay as it is. Return the complete 2x2 sprite sheet with true transparency, no grid lines, text, numbers, floor or shadows, no duplicated pose. High-definition soft sculpted 3D-prerender appearance, solid opaque figure and anti-aliased edges.
entries.reason: Opposite contact pose still repeats apparent leading foot; continuous identity drifts. Kept in Downloads only.
